অন্যান্য কর্মধারয় সমাস

কখনো কখনো সর্বনাম, সংখ্যাবাচক শব্দ এবং উপসর্গ আগে বসে পরপদের সাথে কর্মধারয় সমাস গঠন করতে পারে। যেমন: কুকর্ম, যথাযোগ্য (অব্যয়), সেকাল, একাল (সর্বনাম), একজন, দোতলা (সংখ্যাবাচক শব্দ), বিকাল, সকাল, বিদেশ, বেসুর (উপসর্গ)।

question: Never------do it again.
explanation:
এটা Inversion এর উদাহরণ।



Inversikn refers to the appearance of the verb in front of the subject which is the reverse of the general order of a sentence.


➤


“Never”, “little”, “rarely” এবং “seldom”-এর পরে ব্যবহৃত হয়):


“Never”, “little”, “rarely” এবং “seldom”-এর পরেও Inversion ব্যবহৃত হতে পারে।




Example:




Never had I seen Samina so tensed.


Little does Sana know about me.


Rarely did Aman went there.


Seldom did I notice her perform in any program.


➤


“Neither”, “Nor” এবং “So”-এর পরে ব্যবহৃত হয়):


“Neither”, “nor” এবং “so”-এর পরেও Inversion-এর ব্যবহার হয়ে থাকে।




Example:




Saira doesn’t like dogs. Neither do I.


Alisha was not present there. Nor was I.


Mom likes rice pudding. So do I.

She operated as a combatant and spy, collecting valuable information about the enemy and participating in direct combat. Her bravery and the risks she took were honored with the Bir Protik award.

Captain Sitara Begum:

Sitara Begum, another brave woman, served as a nurse and guerrilla fighter. She provided medical assistance to the injured fighters and also engaged in direct combat. Her outstanding contributions were also acknowledged with the Bir Protik award.

The recognition of these two women highlights the important and often understated role that women played during the liberation war of Bangladesh
